verdict.rationale: The Embedded Payroll API documents employee federal and state tax configuration as part of onboarding (gusto-docs-37, gusto-docs-63) and exposes an employees endpoint (gusto-docs-43). The official agent-friendly CLI ships `gusto employee` and `gusto compensation` commands, with `--dry-run` previews of create requests and a `--confirm` write gate (gusto-contest-61-1), and the Dev Assistant MCP lets AI tools call the API (gusto-docs-6). However, nothing shows an explicit create-employee or create-compensation endpoint or a documented end-to-end new-hire flow; the CLI is framed around per-cycle payroll prep rather than onboarding. Missing for 10: explicit employee-creation and compensation-setup API documentation, a documented end-to-end agent onboarding flow combining employee, compensation and tax setup, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
